items.issue: Installer banner reported v3.9.7.1 inside the v3.9.7.2 package
items.fix: Installer and runtime reporting now use 3.9.7.3-installer-stability.
items.verification: version regression test and CLI smoke test

items.issue: Optional Python tools were installed into the shared user site and replaced pydantic, protobuf, networkx, ruamel.yaml, packaging and related dependencies
items.fix: Each optional pip/pipx catalog tool now receives a dedicated virtual environment under TBHM_TOOL_HOME; no optional Python app is installed into the shared user site.
items.verification: source regression, mocked install tests, pip command inspection

items.issue: giskard, modelscan, whylogs and SuzieQ were attempted on unsupported Python 3.13
items.fix: Interpreter constraints and side-by-side interpreter selection are evaluated before pip. Unsupported combinations are explicit skipped-incompatible results.

items.issue: SuzieQ recipe expected a non-existent suzieq executable
items.fix: Catalog now uses suzieq-cli and recognizes sq-poller; a safe_cli install fails truthfully if no declared executable appears.

items.issue: whylogs was treated as a command-line application
items.fix: whylogs is catalogued as an isolated library; no nonexistent CLI is required.

items.issue: npm global installs failed with EACCES under /usr/local
items.fix: npm recipes use npm install --global --prefix ~/.local and PATH includes ~/.local/bin.

items.issue: cargo-audit failed because dependency resolution exceeded the installed Rust MSRV
items.fix: cargo recipes add --locked; incompatible failures remain visible rather than being mislabeled successful.

items.issue: archived kubeaudit root-module install was attempted
items.fix: kubeaudit is retained for compatibility/import but auto-install is skipped-deprecated with an explanation.

items.issue: apt package presence used dpkg -l exit status and falsely reported gdb installed
items.fix: Presence requires exact dpkg-query status 'install ok installed'.

items.issue: apt failures such as unavailable osquery, Zeek dependency conflicts and transient rtl-433 mirror failures appeared as generic failures
items.fix: apt recipes are preflighted, simulated, classified as unavailable/incompatible/platform, use IPv4/fix-missing, and retry only bounded transient failures.

items.issue: Playwright browser download hid useful diagnostics and left the crawler unusable
items.fix: Playwright is isolated, browser install output is visible, and smart_crawl can fall back to an existing system Chromium when the managed browser is unavailable.

items.issue: Syft was absent after the installer
items.fix: Syft uses the reviewed official installer via a temporary file into ~/.local/bin.
items.verification: installer source/static validation; no live network install claimed

items.issue: Ruby gems and Composer applications installed outside PATH
items.fix: Ruby uses --user-install; Ruby and Composer user bin paths are discovered and canonical executables are linked into ~/.local/bin.

items.issue: TruffleHog installer was piped directly to sudo sh in /usr/local/bin
items.fix: Script is downloaded with bounded curl options to a temporary file and invoked into the user-owned local bin without a shell pipeline or sudo.

items.issue: angr, Playwright and DuckDB would be isolated but unavailable to TBHM runtime code
items.fix: angr triage can re-exec with its isolated interpreter, smart_crawl imports isolated Playwright, and data analysis uses an isolated DuckDB subprocess helper.

items.issue: A previous failed v3.9.7.2 run may have left conflicting top-level packages in the user site
items.fix: Added offline installer_doctor and a conservative plan-first cleanup tool. --apply removes only known top-level optional distributions when an isolated replacement marker exists; it never downgrades shared libraries automatically.
